newsitem.title: USA: Plains fed cattle market quiet, no sales - trade.
newsitem.headline: Plains fed cattle market quiet, no sales - trade.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets near midday Friday remained inactive following active sales near midweek, feedlot sources said.
Feedlots were very current and were expected to price cattle next week at $73.00 per cwt, or higher, versus this week's sales at $71.00, the sources said.
Prices were expected to gain support from the continued tight supply of high-yielding cattle, they said.
Many feedlots the past two weeks have been taking advantage of increased profitability by marketing ahead of schedule, which has cut the supply of choice graded cattle.
